{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]]
* 2 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], chopped
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinches]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ½ small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], chopped

== Procedure ==

# Heat a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over medium heat, and add oil.
# Add tomato and cucumber to the pan. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add salt.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the eggs with the onion and additional salt if desired. Transfer mixture to the pan.
# Cook eggs and vegetables, turning every 30 seconds until cooked to taste.
# Serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If desired, you can fry the eggs and vegetables separately.
